shellCommands.command: npm install --save next@^15 react@^19 react-dom@^19 && npm install --save-dev typescript @types/react @types/react-dom @types/node

npm run start -- -p 3737 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &
sleep 6
curl -s http://localhost:3737/ -o /tmp/home.html -w "HOME %{http_code}\n"
curl -s http://localhost:3737/book/does-not-exist -o /tmp/missing.html -w "404  %{http_code}\n"

cat /tmp/next.log | tail -10
echo "---"
grep -c "Add a book" /tmp/home.html
grep -c "Currently reading" /tmp/home.html
grep -c "Finished" /tmp/home.html
grep -c "Book not found" /tmp/missing.html

curl -s http://localhost:3737/ -o /tmp/home2.html
grep -c "Pragmatic" /tmp/home2.html
grep -c "Hail Mary" /tmp/home2.html
grep -c "Currently reading (1)" /tmp/home2.html
grep -c "Finished (1)" /tmp/home2.html
echo "---"
curl -s http://localhost:3737/book/the-pragmatic-programmer -o /tmp/detail.html -w "DETAIL %{http_code}\n"
grep -c "The Pragmatic Programmer" /tmp/detail.html
grep -c "Hunt & Thomas" /tmp/detail.html
grep -c "pragmatic with code" /tmp/detail.html
grep -c "/book/the-pragmatic-programmer" /tmp/detail.html
echo "---"
curl -s http://localhost:3737/book/project-hail-mary -o /tmp/detail2.html -w "DETAIL2 %{http_code}\n"
grep -c "Finished" /tmp/detail2.html
grep -c "Andy Weir" /tmp/detail2.html

grep -o "Hunt[^<]*" /tmp/detail.html
grep -o "Currently reading[^<]*" /tmp/home2.html
grep -o "Finished[^<]*" /tmp/home2.html
grep -o "book/the-pragmatic-programmer" /tmp/detail.html | head -3
